title: Definition, risk factors and the two pathophysiology arms
guide: Blood pressure as force of pulsatile flow, the CO times SVR product with the page's SVR expansion, the risk-factor tree with hemorrhagic stroke and the 10 mmHg benefit figures, the pressure natriuresis argument, and the SVR remodeling arm.

title: Types, risk factors and grading versus staging
guide: Primary and secondary division with its 5-10% figure, heritability and obesity labels, the dietary list, vasoconstrictor and vasodilator columns, the six-row grades table with its and versus and/or switch, and the three clinical stages.

title: Measuring blood pressure and the renal secondary causes
guide: ABPM as the first choice with the office, daytime, night-time, 24-hour and home cut-offs, the office and home confirmation protocols, and the renal, coarctation and OSAS branches with unilateral versus bilateral renal artery stenosis.

title: Endocrine hypertension, work-up and when to treat
guide: The low-renin monogenic list with Liddle, AME, GRA and Geller, the Gordon versus PHA type I comparison, the acquired endocrine list, the investigation panel with the Doppler study and central systolic pressure, and the treatment thresholds with age-based targets.

title: Front-line drugs and ESH combination therapy
guide: The A, C, D and B classes with beta-blockers reserved for three indications, ARB preference with starting doses, benidipine and indapamide placements, the 60% to 90% response ladder and the eGFR split for resistant hypertension.

title: Resistant options and the CAD and CKD scenarios
guide: Beta-blockers, prazosin, clonidine and renal denervation for resistant hypertension, the A plus B start for coronary disease with angina-driven add-ons, and the A plus C start for CKD with the 30 mL/min fork.
